function agent_event_hash(text,jsonb).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_event_hash(prev_hash text, payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(
    sha256(convert_to(coalesce(prev_hash, '') || CAST(payload AS text), 'UTF8')),
    'hex'
  );
$function$

function audit_trail_hash(text,bigint,ti.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_trail_hash(prev_hash text, seq bigint, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, late boolean, payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.agent_event_hash(prev_hash, payload || jsonb_build_object(
    'seq', seq,
    'late', late,
    -- UTC text, so the hash does not depend on the session's TimeZone.
    'occurred_at',
    to_char(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')
  ));
$function$

view enabled_integrations:
SELECT integration_id,
    integration_name,
    integration_type,
    config,
    last_test_at,
    last_test_success,
    updated_at
   FROM integration_configs
  WHERE (enabled = true)
  ORDER BY integration_name;
view recent_config_changes:
SELECT config_type,
    config_key,
    action,
    changed_by,
    "timestamp",
    change_reason
   FROM config_audit_log
  ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
 LIMIT 100;
